Subject: Post-call: Key custody options + SOC2 evidence request

Hi Tom / Priya —

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking through your inference use case and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps below. I’m copying Jonas (solutions) who’ll help scope the technical PoC and Monica from our security team in the next message for detailed questionnaire items.

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary workload: patient triage summaries and anonymized embeddings for clinical search (low PII for prototypes).
- Compliance: HIPAA baseline required; GDPR data subject rights applicable for EU patients.
- Preference: They want options for customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption, and clarity on in-transit protections.

Action items / next steps:
1) I’m attaching our vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 summary — please confirm which sections you want our security team to expand on ("Encryption & Key Management", "Data Residency", "Access Controls").
2) Please indicate whether Helix will require BYOK/CMK for production (we can run a short PoC for CMK integration if you need a proof-of-concept).
3) Jonas and I will draft a high-level PoC scope (expected duration 2–3 weeks) if you confirm BYOK; otherwise we’ll provide recommended provider-managed KMS profiles optimized for latency/cost.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire_2026.pdf (fillable), redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf, byok-technical-overview.pdf

Timing: If you can let us know by EOD Wednesday (12/01) we’ll lock the PoC plan and resources.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

Thanks Vanessa — good summary. A couple quick clarifications before we kick off the questionnaire:

- On CMK: Our security lead prefers customer-managed keys for any PHI in production. For the pilot (non-PHI), provider-managed keys are OK. Ultimately we’ll want an option to rotate keys via our KMS (Azure Key Vault).
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports HSM-backed key storage when we bring our own key material?
- For latency-sensitive inference, are there recommended instance types or configuration notes in the BYOK document that impact token latency?

We’ll start filling the questionnaire; expecting procurement to coordinate contract language next week.
